title: Dynamic loading for streaming visualization
description:
Implement dynamic loading to optimize memory usage during streaming:

**Requirements:**
- Only send records that will be visualized to the view
- View can request more records from the provider (forward loading)
- View can re-request older records (backward loading/history)
- Streaming service tracks source file position for rollback capability
- Configurable in-memory record limit (default: 1000 entries)

**Technical Considerations:**
- File position tracking for seeking backwards
- Circular buffer or similar structure for memory-bounded storage
- Pagination/windowing API between view and streaming service
- Cache eviction strategy when limit exceeded
